description_en: A circular bowl chair with a deep woven shell and round loose cushion resting on a separate conical ring base; the front shows the open bowl, the side reveals its tilted rim and ring cradle, and the rear exposes radial shell ribs and the base contact points. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
